text:
[p1]
2025/01
STI-088GP-BT
s.sagatelecom@gmail.com
Saga Telecom
www.sagatelecom.com.cn
Model STI-088GP-BT
Product Name 8 port 10/100/1000Mbps Industrial PoE Switch
Fixed Port 8*10/100/1000M RJ45 PoE port
PoE Ports 1 port supports TEEE802.3af/at/poe++/bt, witha maximum power of 90W per port
2-8 ports support IEEE802.3af/at, with a maximum single port power of 30W
PoE Dog Support
. af/at: 12+ 36-
PoE: Pin affat/poe+t/bt: 12+ 45+ 36- 78-
Bandwidth 16Gbps
Packet Forwarding 11.9Mpps
MAC 2K
Buffer 2.5M
Transmission Distance
10BASE-T: Cat3, 4, 5 UTP(<250 meter)
100BASE-TX: Cats or later UTP(150 meter)
1000BASE-TX: Cat6 or later UTP(150 meter)
LED Indicator
PWR: Power indicator (green)
Uplink port: green 100M+ orange 1000M
PoE port: orange PoE indicator, green grid connection indicator.
V1: Main power indicator (green)
V2: Slave power indicator (green)
V3: DC power indicator (green)
VLAN: Port isolation indicator (green)
S: ultra-far mode on indicator (green)
Power
Three groups of independent power input
PoE: DC37-57V
Operating Temperature -40°C~+75°C
Humidity 10%~90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature -40°C~+85°C
Humidity
5%~95% RH No condensation
Dimension Device: 156*119*35mm
L*W*H Packing Box: 235*165*78mm
N.W/G.W(Kg) 0.9Kg/1.1Kg
Lightning 6KV 8/20us, 8KV ESD electrostatic protection
Protection level IP40
Installation Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
te CE-EMC EN55032; CE-LVD EN62368
Certificate
FCC Part 15Class B; RoHS
Operating Temperature
Humidity
-40°C~#75°C
10%~ 90% RH No condensation
